policy: Official reference originals are not shipped. Run `node src/cli.mjs references-fetch` to download each PDF from its official URL and check it against the SHA-256 below. A matching hash proves byte identity with the version pinned when this release was prepared; it does not prove the text is current law. A different hash usually means the publisher updated the document: the file is kept as an unverified candidate for your review.
